## Dialog.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `open` :: Whether the dialog is open. Bind it, or let the `trigger` drive it.
- `onOpenChange` :: Called whenever the dialog opens or closes — by the trigger, Esc, the backdrop or the close button.
- `title` :: The heading. Wired to the dialog as its accessible name (`aria-labelledby`).
- `description` :: A line under the heading. Wired as the accessible description (`aria-describedby`).
- `width` :: The width, on the measure ladder. `full` fills the viewport less a margin.
- `gap` :: The space between the title and the description in the header.
- `textSize` :: Text scale of the title.
- `childTextSize` :: Text scale of the description.
- `bodyTextSize` :: Text scale of the body.
- `childTextColor` :: Ink of the description and the body.
- `dismissible` :: Whether Esc and a click on the backdrop close the dialog.
- `closeButton` :: Shows a close button in the top-right corner.
- `closeButtonProps` :: Props forwarded to the close Button, so a caller can change its variant, size or ink.
- `scrollBehavior` :: `inside` scrolls the body between a fixed header and footer; `outside` lets the whole panel scroll past the viewport.
- `surface` :: The panel fill: opaque, or frosted glass.
- `trigger` :: Renders the element that opens the dialog. Spread `props` onto your own button.
- `children` :: The body. Receives `close`.
- `footer` :: The action row at the bottom, aligned to the end. Receives `close`.

## dialog.ts

### `type DialogScrollBehavior`

What scrolls when the content is taller than the viewport.

### `type OverlaySurface`

The fill of an overlay surface: opaque, or frosted glass.

### `interface OverlayTrigger`

What a `trigger` snippet receives: props to spread on your own button, and the controls.

- `props` :: Spread onto the trigger element: ARIA wiring and the click handler.
- `isOpen` :: Whether the overlay is open.
- `open` :: Opens the overlay.
- `close` :: Closes the overlay.
- `toggle` :: Opens it if closed, closes it if open.

### `interface OverlayContent`

What a content snippet (`children`, `footer`) receives.

- `close` :: Closes the overlay.

### `const surfaceClass`

The surface classes of a raised overlay panel.
